scope: Unknown buy/sell POST outcomes; error XSS; test assertions; no product edits or deployment

findings.problem: Every HTTP 4xx is classified as definite rejection although status alone does not establish noncreation. Reproduced 408 {} and contradictory 409 ok:true with valid ids on both buy and sell: UI says rejected with no unknown/no-repeat guidance.
findings.requested_change: Treat unproven and contradictory 4xx responses as unknown; retain explicit application rejection only with a sufficiently narrow verified contract. Add regression cases for empty 408 and contradictory 4xx success bodies.
findings.resolution: Removed blanket 4xx classification. Known current precreation HTTPException statuses 400/403/429 require string detail, no ids, and absent/false ok. Structured 2xx rejection requires action-specific string reason and no ids. Other/contradictory replies stay unknown. Regression tests cover 408/409, empty 400, contradictory 403/429, and invalid success ids.
